_comment: {{Lang}} naming for the AWS CDK assembly closure — the JSII_{{LANG}}_TARGET_CONFIG overlay consumed by src/target-config.ts. Upstream repos do not carry targets.{{lang}}, so naming arrives at generation time via this file. Values are LOAD-BEARING: they become published package and module names (permanent public API). Every top-level aws-cdk-lib submodule (~330 of them) is a naming decision — scripts/check-cdk-naming.js fails until each is recorded, which makes the decisions deliberate rather than silently derived. The Ruby reference's completed file is a worked example: https://github.com/omarqureshi/jsii-target-ruby/blob/main/config/cdk-targets.json
